package fixture_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"testing"

	"example.com/replayfixture/fixture"
)

// The toy wiring: replayOps over the in-memory toy middleware. A real service writes the same
// shape over its own store (see docs/idempotency-replay-classes.md); only this file names a driver.
func newReplayOps(t *testing.T) replayOps {
	t.Helper()
	store := fixture.NewStore()
	return replayOps{
		Catalogue: func() []problemEntry {
			var out []problemEntry
			for _, p := range fixture.ProblemTypes() {
				out = append(out, problemEntry{Slug: p.Slug, Status: p.Status, Class: p.Class})
			}
			return out
		},
		Middleware: func(_ *testing.T, next http.Handler) http.Handler {
			return fixture.RequireIdempotencyKey(store)(next)
		},
		Refuse: func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request, e problemEntry) { fixture.Refuse(w, e.Slug) },
		Write: func(ctx context.Context, tag string) error {
			tx, ok := fixture.TxFrom(ctx)
			if !ok {
				return errors.New("the middleware did not bind a transaction")
			}
			tx.Add(tag)
			return nil
		},
		Committed: func(_ *testing.T, tag string) int { return store.Committed(tag) },
		KeyRows:   func(_ *testing.T, key string) int { return store.KeyRows(key) },
	}
}
